author: Shri Raghavendra Swami
commentary: मदनुग्रहायेति द्वाभ्याम् । परमं गुह्यमतिहोप्यं आत्मानं भगवन्तं अधिकृत्य स्थितमध्यात्मं अध्यात्मनामकं यद्वचः त्वया मदनुग्रहायोक्तम् । तेन बन्धुस्नेहादिरूपोऽयं मोहो विगतोऽपगतः मम ॥ ११.१॥
translation:
Arjuna said: What word, out of compassion for me, the supreme secret called the Adhyatma, has been spoken by Thee, by that my present delusion is gone.
V. Adhyatma: (Atma: the Lord); regarding the Lord; treating of the Lord. Delusion, viz., my false attachment to kinsmen, &c. (1)
